release_title: The Llama 4 herd: The beginning of a new era of natively multimodal AI innovation

models.name: Llama 4 Maverick
models.variant: 17B active / 128 experts / 400B total; workhorse multimodal model
models.capability_summary: 发布文称 Maverick 为 Llama 4 herd 中的主力多模态模型（17B 激活、128 专家、400B 总参，MoE 架构）。评测覆盖多模态理解、知识、代码与克丘亚语翻译，亮点为 DocVQA 94.4 与 ChartQA 90.0（LMArena Elo 1417 归属于实验性聊天版本）。

models.name: Llama 4 Scout
models.variant: 17B active / 16 experts / 109B total; 10M context, single H100 GPU
models.capability_summary: 发布文称 Scout 以 17B 激活、16 专家、109B 总参实现单张 H100 可部署，并将上下文长度从 Llama 3 的 128K 提升至业界领先的 10M。评测以多模态与知识为主，亮点为 DocVQA 94.4 与 ChartQA 88.8。

models.name: Llama 4 Behemoth
models.variant: 288B active / 16 experts / ~2T total; teacher model, still training at announcement (preview)
models.capability_summary: 发布文将其定位为仍在训练中的教师模型（约 2T 总参、288B 激活、16 专家），以当前最佳内部运行结果预览。评测显示知识与推理领先，亮点为 MATH-500 95.0 与 MMLU-Pro 82.2。

notes: ai.meta.com blocks both web readers — fetched via headless browser per README degradation path; page header prints 'April 5, 2025'. Note the assignment URL /llama-4-maverick-scout/ 404s; canonical slug is /llama-4-multimodal-intelligence/. Prose evidence is thin by design: exactly 3 verified rows (LMArena Elo 1417 explicitly attributed to an EXPERIMENTAL CHAT VERSION of Maverick; MATH-500 and GPQA Diamond named for the still-training Behemoth with outperforms claims, no printed numbers). Three benchmark tables are fbcdn PNG images (signed expiring URLs — locators use section+row): Maverick table (1-shot temp-0 footnote), Scout table (0-shot temp-0 footnote — different protocol from Maverick!), Behemoth table ('current best internal runs' footnote). 24 pending rows carry visual-read values in notes only per §12.5. Also image-only and not converted to rows: NIH heatmap panels (Maverick 1M / Scout 10M / Scout video 20h — qualitative blue/white grids), the cumulative-NLL-over-code curve, and the Maverick-vs-GPT-4o/Gemini-2.0-Flash/DeepSeek-v3.1 cost row ($0.19-$0.49 blended, Artificial Analysis sourcing for non-Llama). Footnote 2 on all tables: non-Llama numbers are highest self-reported results from reproducible (API or open-weight) non-thinking models — competitor columns are curated, not same-protocol runs.
